account.reason: Only selected native balance or selected account code is returned; no global-root read.

address.reason: Registration appends a caller-specified address; reads and RLP codecs return supplied-address records, not all execution.

legacy.reason: Body returns a constant, empty-table error, caller-directed gas burn, or no data; Statistics adds only the current L2 number.

pricing.reason: Fees, configuration, scalar/resource backlogs and accounting aggregates; additions, weighted sums, saturation and time decay do not authenticate transaction/effect content or order.

poster.reason: Poster membership or fee recipient, constant default, or legacy zero/no-op; privileged mutations write selected poster configuration.

config.reason: Current membership/configuration fields; rectifyChainOwner requires an existing membership and repairs its mapping, not an execution history.

stylus.reason: Selected codehash activation metadata, packed program parameters, age/size/cost/cache fields, or activation data fee. Module identity and activation state are not an ordered all-execution accumulator.

retry.reason: Selected-ticket properties, timeout, beneficiary-controlled cancellation, current refund address or scheduled future transaction hash; no preceding all-transaction commitment.

context.reason: Block/chain/version or current call-frame/alias data, or constant storage-gas zero; no executing-prefix input.

ancestor.reason: Requires n-256 <= requested < n; GetHash walks ancestor headers, not current execution. Current block roots are finalized after execution.

outbox.reason: Hashes caller/destination/block/time/value/supplied data and appends only sends; send returns leaf index at 61. Exported root is additionally zero-caller-only. Ordinary token transfers need not append leaves.

owner.reason: Every method, including getters, is checked by ownerOnly; bodies read or alter configuration/membership/pricing, not an ordered prefix.

debug.reason: DebugMode is required; bodies return supplied values/selected prior code/errors or mutate state. No prefix oracle even in this non-admitted configuration.

internal.reason: All ordinary handlers unconditionally return CallerNotArbOS; actual internal transaction processing is a distinct path, not a forged ordinary caller.

native.reason: NativeTokenOwners membership required; only caller native balance mint/burn and events; no commitment return.

filter.reason: Public getter tests a supplied hash against a mutable filter bit. Authorized add/delete and protocol cleanup do not authenticate transaction inclusion, ordered execution or a complete prefix.
